title: SmartArt-like drawing docx 001
notes: python-docx cannot emit diagrams: raw w:drawing with two separate inline wps:wsp shapes (rect + ellipse) carrying wps:txbx text, injected via parse_xml. LibreOffice renders shape txbx text into the PDF text layer, so the labels are reference text. DrawingML shapes only — no diagram parts, not MS-generated SmartArt.
